description:
[Single AML rulebook customer due diligence risk scorer. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates customer risk tier (Low, Medium, High, Unacceptable) under Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 based on entity structure, geography, delivery channels, and volume, specifying mandatory EDD controls.
Usage: Pass customer onboarding attributes to determine mandatory CDD vs EDD requirements and senior management approval triggers.
Returns: JSON object with { customerName: string, riskScore: number, riskTier: string, dueDiligenceLevelRequired: string, mandatoryComplianceMeasures: array, riskFactorBreakdown: object }.

customerName.description: Customer corporate legal name or individual full name

expectedAnnualTransactionVolumeEur.description: Anticipated annual transaction volume in EUR

isCashIntensiveBusiness.description: Whether business operates in cash-heavy sectors (dining, gambling, art, foreign exchange)

isCryptoVirtualAssetProvider.description: Whether entity is a Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP/CASP)

isHighNetWorthIndividual.description: Whether individual customer holds liquid assets exceeding €1M

jurisdictionCountryIso2.description: 2-letter ISO country code of customer incorporation or primary residence

name: aml_customer_risk_scorer
